title: PrettyMarker Paper
description: An additional plugin for the "Share" feature in the PrettyMarker mod.
body:
An additional plugin for the "Share" feature in the [PrettyMarker](https://modrinth.com/mod/prettymarker) mod.

The share function will work if the plugin is installed on your server, and when you click share, players who have the client mod installed will be displayed.

![Marker Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Q08ml90M/images/fe33764afa800d3f001c68c50bc96aca13db9714.png)
